name: Imposter Syndrome
source:
You were invited to a chat group for professor Stone's General Psychology course but wait- you don't even study there!?

Since you'd get added to the group again even if you left, enjoy your time with the students and maybe find love while you're at it. I mean, they're hot.

[From [url=https://glonicera.itch.io/is]Itch.io[/url]]
